## Compare and contrast between lung and blood OCRs

### Peak overlapping with barplots

```{r, fig.width = 10}
load("output/peakCalling/peaks_called_by_TissueCellType.RData")
fpath <- "~/cluster/data/features/formatted/Benaglio2023"
blood_list <- list()
for(i in c(ct_order[1:4], "CD4_T", "tReg")){
  bed <- fread(sprintf("%s/scBlood_%s.bed", fpath, i))
  cur <- GRanges(seqnames = bed$V1,
                 ranges = IRanges(start = bed$V2,
                 end = bed$V3))
  seqlevelsStyle(cur) <- "UCSC"  # necessary
  if(i == "tReg"){i = "Treg"}
  blood_list[[paste0("Blood_", i)]] <- unlist(liftOver(cur, ch))
}

count_tbl <-
  sapply(ct_order, function(i) {
    counts <- length(unique(as.character(d_major[[paste0("Lung_", i)]])))
    # match lung CD4_T subsets with blood CD4_T
    if(grepl("[.]", i) == TRUE){
      new_i <- strsplit(i, "[.]")[[1]][2]
    }else{
      new_i = i
    }
    hits <-
      findOverlaps(d_major[[paste0("Lung_", i)]],
                   blood_list[[paste0("Blood_", new_i)]])
    return(c(counts - length(unique(hits@from)), length(unique(hits@from))))
  })

rownames(count_tbl) <- c("not shared", "shared")
p1 <-
ggplot(
  data.frame(count_tbl) %>%
    mutate(group = rownames(count_tbl)) %>%
    pivot_longer(!group,
                 values_to = "counts",
                 names_to = "CellType"),
  aes(
    y = counts,
    x = factor(CellType, 
               levels = gsub("[/]", ".", ct_order),
               labels = ct_order2),
    fill = group
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) + xlab("")  +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 125000, 25000),
                     labels = c(0, paste0(seq(0, 125, 25), "K")[-1])) + 
  ylab("Number of OCRs") + 
  scale_fill_discrete() + 
  theme_pub(base_size = 13) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.6),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

## heritability enrichment with S-LDSC 

### heritability enrichment one focal cell type at a time

```{r, fig.height = 3, fig.width = 7.5}
trait_list <- c("AllergicRhinitis", "aoa_ukb", "coa_ukb", "height", "bmi", "IPF", "COPD", "COVID19")
trait_labels<- c("AR", "AOA", "COA", "Height", "BMI", "IPF", "COPD", "COVID19")


annotations <- data.frame(
  annot_id = c(paste0("scBlood_", c("B", "T", "NK")),
               #paste0("Blood_", "merged"),
               paste0("Lung_", c("B", "T", "NK"))),
  annotations = c(paste0("Blood_", c("B", "T", "NK")),
                  #paste0("Blood_", "merged"),
                  paste0("Lung_", c("B", "T", "NK")))
)

ldsc_tbl<-make_summary_table(traits = trait_list, 
                             referenceTab = annotations,
                             baseline="baseline_v1.2")

# change the names of traits
ldsc_tbl$trait <- trait_dict(ldsc_tbl$trait)
# compute for tau star statistics
correct_tbl <- compute_tau_star(ldsc_tbl, annotations$annot_id)
# identify FDR and Bonferroni cutoffs
fdr <- p.adjust(correct_tbl$tau_star_p, method = "fdr")
fdr_cutoff <- max(correct_tbl$tau_star_p[fdr <= 0.05])
bonf <- p.adjust(correct_tbl$tau_star_p, method = "bonferroni")
bonf_cutoff <- max(correct_tbl$tau_star_p[bonf <= 0.05])
annot_list <- annotations$annot_id
annot_list <-c(
  annot_list[grepl("_T", annot_list)],
  annot_list[grepl("_B", annot_list)],
  annot_list[grepl("_NK", annot_list)])

correct_ldsc_tbl <-
  correct_tbl %>% 
  mutate(Category = factor(Category,
                           levels= annot_list,
                           labels = gsub("sc", "", annot_list)),
         trait = factor(trait, 
                        levels = trait_labels))

category_order  = unlist(lapply(c("B", "NK", "T"), function(i){paste0(c("Lung_", "Blood_"), i)}))

p2_a <-
ggplot( correct_ldsc_tbl %>%
         mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = rev(gsub("sc", "", annot_list)))),
         aes(x = -log10(as.numeric(tau_star_p)),
             y = Category)) + 
         geom_col(position = "dodge2", width = 0.3)  + 
         xlab("-log10(tau* p-value)") + ylab("") + 
         facet_grid(~ trait) + 
         geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(bonf_cutoff),
                    linetype = "dotted") + 
         geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(fdr_cutoff),
                    linetype = "dashed") +
         theme_pub(base_size = 13)
p2_a
```

### Joint test of lung and blood separately for each major lymphocyte

Compared with blood, open chromatin regions of lung T cells are significantly enriched for genetic risks of allergy, atopic dermatitis, and asthma, but not for control traits as well as IPF and COPD. Lung NK cells also show moderate enrichment.

```{r fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3}
ldsc_tbl <- c()
for (trait in trait_list) {
  for (c in c("T", "B", "NK")){
    f <- read.table(sprintf("~/cluster/projects/ldsc_enrichment/%s/baseline_v1.2/Joint_2%s.results", trait, c), header = T)
    f <- f[!grepl("L2_0", f$Category), ]
    f$Category <- unlist(
      lapply(f$Category, function(i){strsplit(i, "L2")[[1]][1]})
      )
    ldsc_tbl<- 
      rbind(ldsc_tbl, cbind(trait, c, f))
  }
}

# change trait name and order
ldsc_tbl$trait <- trait_dict(ldsc_tbl$trait)

tissues <- c("Lung", "scBlood")
main_ct <- c("B", "NK", "T")
correct_tbl <- compute_tau_star(ldsc_tbl, annotations$annot_id)
fdr <- p.adjust(correct_tbl$tau_star_p, method = "fdr")
fdr_cutoff <- max(correct_tbl$tau_star_p[fdr <= 0.05])
bonf <- p.adjust(correct_tbl$tau_star_p, method = "bonferroni")
bonf_cutoff <- max(correct_tbl$tau_star_p[bonf <= 0.05])

# change order and labels
correct_tbl$Category <- factor(correct_tbl$Category,
                      levels = annotations$annot_id,
                      labels = annotations$annotations)
annot_list <- annotations$annotations
h2g_ldsc_tbl <-
  correct_tbl %>%
  mutate(
     Enrichment_p = pnorm(-abs(Coefficient_z.score)) * 2,
     trait = factor(trait, levels = trait_labels),
     Category = factor(Category,
                       levels = c(annot_list[grepl("_T", annot_list)],
                                  annot_list[grepl("_B", annot_list)],
                                  annot_list[grepl("_NK", annot_list)]))
)
```

```{r, fig.height = 3, fig.width = 7.5}
p2_b <-
  ggplot(h2g_ldsc_tbl %>% 
            mutate(Category = factor(Category,
                                    levels = rev(levels(Category)))),
           aes(x = -log10(tau_star_p),
               y = Category,
               fill = c)) +
           geom_col(position = "dodge2", width = 0.3) + 
           xlab("-log10(tau* p-value)") + ylab("") + 
           facet_grid(~ trait) + 
           geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(bonf_cutoff),
                      linetype = "dotted") + 
           geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(fdr_cutoff),
                      linetype = "dashed") +
           theme_pub(base_size = 14) + 
           theme(legend.position = "none")

p2_b
```

### One focal cell type vs. lung-blood union peaks

```{r}

annotations <- data.frame(
  annot_id = paste0("Joint_ct_", c("NaiveB", "MemB", "NK", 
                                "CD8T", "CD8.CD4T", "CD4T", "Th17", "Treg")),
  annotations = paste0("Lung_", c("Naive_B", "Memory_B", "NK", 
                                  "CD8_T", "CD8.CD4_T", "CD4_T", "Th17_T", "Treg_T"))
)


ldsc_tbl<-make_summary_table(traits = trait_list, 
                             referenceTab = annotations,
                             baseline="baseline_v1.2")

ldsc_tbl$Category[ldsc_tbl$Category == "Lung_CD8"] <- "Lung_CD8.CD4_T"
ldsc_tbl <- ldsc_tbl[ldsc_tbl$Category %in% annotations[, 2], ]

# change the names of traits
ldsc_tbl$trait <- trait_dict(ldsc_tbl$trait)
correct_tbl <- compute_tau_star(ldsc_tbl, annotations$annotations)

correct_ldsc_tbl <-
  correct_tbl %>% 
  mutate(Category = factor(Category,
                           levels = annotations[, 2],
                           labels = gsub("[.]", "/", ct_order2)),
         trait = factor(trait, 
                        levels = trait_labels))
```

Heatmap for the joint analysis 

```{r, fig.width = 8}
p3 <-
ggplot(
    correct_ldsc_tbl %>% 
      mutate(
        Category = factor(Category, levels = rev(levels(Category))),
        FDR = p.adjust(tau_star_p, method = "bonferroni"),
        Enrichment = ifelse(Enrichment > 0, Enrichment, NA)),
    aes(
      x = trait,
      y = Category,
      fill = -log10(tau_star_p),
      label = ifelse(FDR <= 0.05, "*", ""))) +
    scale_colour_viridis_b(alpha = 0.9) + 
    scale_size_continuous() + 
    geom_tile() + xlab("") + ylab("") + 
    geom_text(size = 8, color = "red") + 
    labs(fill = "-log10(tau* p-value)") + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, vjust = 0.6),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.position = "bottom")
p3
```

## Are transciptome informed peaks explaining more heritability?

```{r}
library(rtracklayer)
e2g <- readRDS("~/cluster/projects/u19_multiomics/analyses/remove_dup/E2G_multiome_pred.RDS")
chains=import.chain("~/resources/genomes/chain_files/hg38ToHg19.over.chain")
library(rtracklayer)
p2g_mapped <-
  lapply(names(e2g), function(i) {
    pos_links  = e2g[[i]][e2g[[i]]$E2G.Score.qnorm >= 0.2]
    if(i == "memCD4_T") {
      ct = "Lung_Th17.CD4_T"
    } else{
      ct = paste0("Lung_", i)
    }
    print(ct)
    links_hg19 <- liftOver(pos_links, chains)
    links_gr <- unlist(links_hg19)
    mapped_gr <- unique(subsetByOverlaps(d_major_hg19[[ct]], links_gr, minoverlap=250))
    bed <- data.frame(mapped_gr)[, 1:3]
    bed[, 1] <- gsub("chr", "", bed[, 1])
    write.table(bed, sprintf("~/cluster/data/features/formatted/u19_multiomics/e2g_links/%s.bed", i),
                quote = F, sep = "\t", row.names = F, col.names = F)
    return(mapped_gr)
  })

names(p2g_mapped) <- names(e2g)

#union set
p2g_union <- unique(c(p2g_mapped$CD4_T, p2g_mapped$memCD4_T, p2g_mapped$Treg, p2g_mapped$CD8.CD4_T, p2g_mapped$CD8_T))
bed <- data.frame(p2g_union)[, 1:3]
bed[, 1] <- gsub("chr", "", bed[, 1])
write.table(bed, sprintf("~/cluster/data/features/formatted/u19_multiomics/e2g_links/%s.bed", "merged_T"), quote = F, sep = "\t", row.names = F, col.names = F)

```

```{r fig.height = 4, fig.width = 12}
annotations <- data.frame(
  annot_id = c(paste0("Lung_E2G_", c("B", "T", "NK")),
               #paste0("Blood_", "merged"),
               paste0("Lung_", c("B", "T", "NK"))),
  annotations = c(paste0("Lung_E2G_", c("B", "T", "NK")),
                  #paste0("Blood_", "merged"),
                  paste0("Lung_", c("B", "T", "NK")))
)

ldsc_tbl<-make_summary_table(traits = trait_list, 
                             referenceTab = annotations,
                             baseline="baseline_v1.2")

# change the names of traits
ldsc_tbl$trait <- trait_dict(ldsc_tbl$trait)

correct_tbl <- compute_tau_star(ldsc_tbl, annotations$annot_id)
fdr <- p.adjust(correct_tbl$tau_star_p, method = "fdr")
fdr_cutoff <- max(correct_tbl$tau_star_p[fdr <= 0.05])
bonf <- p.adjust(correct_tbl$tau_star_p, method = "bonferroni")
bonf_cutoff <- max(correct_tbl$tau_star_p[bonf <= 0.05])
annot_list <- annotations$annot_id
annot_list <-c(
  annot_list[grepl("_T", annot_list)],
  annot_list[grepl("_B", annot_list)],
  annot_list[grepl("_NK", annot_list)])

correct_ldsc_tbl <-
  correct_tbl %>% 
  mutate(Category = factor(Category,
                           levels= annot_list),
         trait = factor(trait, 
                        levels = trait_labels))
e2g_compare <- correct_ldsc_tbl
snp_percent = 100*(e2g_compare$Prop._SNPs[match(annot_list, e2g_compare$Category)])
p4 <-
ggplot(e2g_compare %>% 
         #filter(!trait %in% c("COVID19", "IPF", "COPD")) %>%
         mutate(Category = factor(Category, 
                                  levels = annot_list,
                                  labels = sprintf("%s\n(%.1f%%)", annot_list, snp_percent))),
         aes(x = log2(Enrichment),
             y = Category)) + 
         geom_col(position = "dodge2", width = 0.3)  + 
         xlab("log2(Enrichment)") + ylab("") + 
         geom_errorbar(aes(xmin=log2(Enrichment)-log2(Enrichment_std_error),
                           xmax=log2(Enrichment)+log2(Enrichment_std_error),
                        width=0.1)) + #xlim(0, 6) + 
         scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 9, 2)) + 
         facet_grid(~ trait) + 
         theme_pub(base_size = 13)
p4
```
